[[Vrek Qwek Spek]] is a [[Hydra]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Dragon's Gullet]].

== Locations ==
* [[Ascalon]]
** {{NPC location|Dragon's Gullet}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Inferno}}
* {{skill icon|Meteor}}
* {{monster skill icon|Stun Immunity}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Leathery Claw]]

== Notes ==
* Vrek Qwek Spek does not spawn during the quest [[The Titan Source]].
* As with most Hydras, Vrek Qwek Spek will usually open up with Meteor and then move into melee range to use [[Inferno]] and begin attacking until its [[skill]]s recharge.

== Trivia ==
* All [[:Category:Hydra bosses|Hydra bosses]] have one name for each head.
